title: 🩺 Free Second Opinion & Online Consultations
h1: Expert Medical Advice from India’s Top Doctors – Before You Travel
intro: Making the right medical decision is crucial. That’s why we provide free second opinions and online consultations with India’s leading specialists. Patients can share medical reports, discuss treatment options, and receive transparent cost estimates — all before traveling. This ensures peace of mind, accurate guidance, and clarity about your treatment plan.

sections.heading: 📋 How Our Free Second Opinion Works
points: Upload Reports: Share scans, test results & prescriptions securely
Doctor Review: Reports evaluated by expert specialists in India
Treatment Options: Get detailed recommendations and alternatives
Cost Estimate: Transparent package pricing shared in advance
Follow-Up: Option for online consultation with the treating doctor

sections.heading: 🖥️ Benefits of Online Consultations
points: Saves travel cost & time before final decision
Access to India’s top surgeons & specialists
Helps compare treatment options & costs
Builds trust and transparency before arrival
Easy follow-up care after returning home

sections.heading: 🌍 Why International Patients Prefer This Service
points: Direct access to doctors trained in USA/UK/Europe
100% secure and confidential sharing of medical records
Available for cardiology, oncology, IVF, neurosurgery, orthopedics & more
Multilingual support for Arabic, Russian, French & African patients
Helps avoid misdiagnosis and unnecessary procedures

sections.heading: 💰 Cost of Online Consultations
points: First Second Opinion: FREE (via email/report review)
Video Consultation (30 mins): $25 – $50
Follow-Up Consultation: $20 – $30
Package for Multiple Consultations: $80 – $120

cta.headline: 📞 Get Trusted Medical Advice Today
points: No cost, no obligation
Transparent medical guidance
Peace of mind before travel
